mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate input costs, leading to reduced profit margins and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the average 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary policy stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the mean 20d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand growth, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction effect is not significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 109.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity and deteriorating business conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the average 5d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a stable or rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates demand growth driven by consumer spending despite labor market weakness, which supports corporate earnings and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) above 200k per month, combined with a stable unemployment rate, signals strong labor market momentum that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable federal funds rate, signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Fed to delay rate cuts, leading to higher real rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) on a quarterly basis, combined with rising residential investment (HOUST), signals strong underlying economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both conditions are met, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).
